# executes procedure

Relates an Execution to the Procedure it enacts. Non-functional: an execution may enact multiple procedures (a combined run), and competing enactment claims coexist.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/executesProcedure>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:executesProcedure`  

**Type:** `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/procedures>
